part5.ex: Presence 是名詞，表現出企業存在感。Present 是形容詞或動詞，不合語意。

part5.q: All applicants ------- provide at least two references when applying for the managerial position.
part5.ex: 指必須提供推薦人，must 正確；have、did 等語意不合句意。

part5.q: Retailers must clearly display the discount percentage ------- the duration of the promotion.
part5.ex: Throughout 表示整個期間。Between 表示兩者之間，時間範圍不明確。

part5.q: The revised supplier agreement included strict penalties ------- late deliveries.
part5.ex: 對於遲延交貨使用 for。To, by, on 搭配皆錯誤。

part5.q: A news conference will be held to announce the merger; -------, details will be shared on the website.
part5.ex: 前後為補充說明，應用 additionally。However 表轉折，語意不符。

part5.q: The brochure provides valuable information for tenants, ------- is updated every year.
part5.ex: 先行詞為物，使用關係代名詞 which。Who 用於人，不正確。

part5.q: Suppliers must ensure that all products ------- quality standards before shipping.
part5.ex: 主詞 products 是複數，動詞需用 meet。Meets 是單數主詞才用。

part5.q: The CEO will arrive at the office ------- the press release is distributed to the media.
part5.ex: 根據句意 CEO 會在發佈後抵達辦公室。During、while 表同時，語意不同。

part5.q: Prospective tenants should carefully ------- the terms of the lease before signing.
part5.ex: 應審查（review）租賃條款才合理。Describe 表描述，意義不同。

part5.q: ------- some products are on sale this week, only members can access the exclusive discounts.
part5.ex: 雖然有特價，但只有會員可享優惠，用 although。If 不符合語境，因為不是條件句。

part5.q: Hiring managers are expected to treat all candidates with -------, regardless of background.
part5.ex: 名詞 fairness 表示公平待遇。Fair 是形容詞，不能作受詞。

part5.q: The airline’s baggage policy states that ------- bags exceeding 23 kg will incur an extra fee.
part5.ex: Checked 為形容詞，修飾名詞 bags。Checking 為動名詞，語意不對。

part5.q: Shoppers can redeem their coupons for ------- at any participating retail stores.
part5.ex: merchandise 作為不可數名詞，代表商品。Merchandises 沒有這個名詞用法。

part5.q: Real estate agents recommend updating the property listing ------- new features are added.
part5.ex: Whenever 表示每當...時，最符合句意。Unless 意為除非，語意不符。

part5.q: The IT manager reminded staff that strong passwords are essential for ------- company data.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 protecting，這裡需要動名詞作為介系詞 for 的受詞；常見誤選 protection，語意不同，不能用作動作的受詞。

part5.q: Because the current office is too small, the company ------- to relocate next month.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 plans，主詞 the company 是單數，動詞需用第三人稱單數現在式；plan 為原形，不符合文法。

part5.q: Applicants should ensure that all required documents are ------- before submitting their job applications.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 completed，documents 需被動式修飾語，表示文件已經完成；complete 形容詞常被誤選，但無法與文件被動搭配。

part5.q: The new employee orientation session ------- by the human resources manager every Monday morning.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 is conducted，這裡需要現在簡單被動；conducting 是現在分詞，語法不通。

part5.q: A library card is required ------- you want to borrow materials from the reference section.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 if，因為表示條件；although 表示讓步，語意不符。

part5.q: During the interview, candidates are encouraged to ask questions ------- the company culture.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 about，問關於公司文化的問題；for 容易誤選，但語意不符。

part5.q: IT security policies ------- regularly to adapt to new threats.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 are updated，需用現在簡單被動表習慣；will update 表示未來，與 regularly 不符。

part5.q: The manager asked ------- to complete the onboarding documents by Friday.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 everyone，因為需要一個代表所有人的主詞；each 和 every 不能單獨作主詞。

part5.q: Due to the office relocation, ------- will be a brief interruption in phone service next week.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 there，需用作存在句的主詞；it 常被誤選但文法不符。

part5.q: The ------- of the health clinic is to provide affordable care to the community.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 purpose，這裡要單數名詞作主詞；purposed 和 purposing 是動詞形式，不符合語意。

part5.q: Employees are reminded not to disclose their passwords ------- any circumstances.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 under any circumstances，固定片語；on 常被誤選但不正確。

part5.q: Some library materials can be renewed online, ------- others must be returned in person.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 while，表示對比；if 表條件，語意不合。

part5.q: All new employees must ------- a health screening before starting work.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 undergo，must 後面要用動詞原形；underwent 是過去式，誤選。

part5.q: Dr. Lee will be available for ------- appointments between 1:00 and 4:00 p.m.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 consultation，需名詞作為 appointments 的修飾語；consult 常被誤選但為動詞。

part5.q: Library users are ------- responsible for returning borrowed items on time.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 personally，需副詞修飾 responsible；personal 是形容詞不能修飾 responsible。

part5.q: New hires ------- to read and sign the employee handbook as part of the onboarding process.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 are required，new hires 為複數，需用複數被動語態；require 是主動，語意不符。

part5.q: ------- the interview was challenging, Mr. Jones felt confident in his responses.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 Although，表示讓步對比；Because 表原因，不合句意。

part5.q: The new clinic facility is equipped ------- state-of-the-art medical devices.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 with，equipped with 為固定搭配；from 是常見誤選但不正確。

part5.q: Each employee received a list of tasks ------- must be completed during the relocation.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 that，用來引導限定性關係子句修飾 tasks；they 是主詞，文法不符。

part5.q: The bank ------- its customers of new digital security measures by sending weekly email updates.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 informs，因主詞為單數 the bank，時態為現在式。informing 是動名詞，與句子結構不符。

part5.q: All staff members must obtain ------- before incurring any additional travel costs.
part5.ex: approval（名詞）才能搭配 obtain；approve、approves 是動詞，approving 是動名詞，均不符合句意。

part5.q: ------- the menu is finalized, the restaurant can begin promoting its grand opening.
part5.ex: Once 用於表示條件“當...之後”；however 和 despite 不符語意，unless 表示“除非”，不合上下文。

part5.q: After the merger was announced, both companies noticed a ------- in employee morale.
part5.ex: 需要名詞 decline，意指“下降”。declined、declining、declines 均非名詞形式。

part5.q: Travelers are advised to check ------- flight status before heading to the airport.
part5.ex: their 為所有格形容詞，修飾名詞 flight status；theirs 不能直接修飾名詞。

part5.q: The finance department reviewed the budget proposal ------- the CEO signed the final approval.
part5.ex: before 符合語意，表示先後順序。although 表示讓步關係，不合句意；in addition 不能作連接詞。

part5.q: The marketing team plans to ------- a press release to announce the new product line.
part5.ex: plans to 後應接動詞原形 issue；issues、issued、issuing 形式不符。

part5.q: Bank customers are encouraged to use online services ------- visiting branches in person.
part5.ex: instead of 表示“而不是”；except 表示“除了”，語意不符；between 用於兩者之間。

part5.q: Delays in budget approval can ------- the launch of new projects.
part5.ex: can 後接動詞原形 postpone；postponement 是名詞、postponed 是過去分詞、postponing 是動名詞/現在分詞。

part5.q: The restaurant's grand opening received ------- from local food critics.
part5.ex: 需要名詞 recognition，表示“認可”；其他選項詞性或型態皆不合。

part5.q: The merger announcement ------- significant changes to the company's organizational structure.
part5.ex: 助動詞 will 後接原形 result in；其他選項動詞形式不正確。

part5.q: Travelers are reminded ------- their expense receipts for reimbursement.
part5.ex: reminded to V 是正常搭配，表示“被提醒去做某事”；submit、submitting、submitted 皆不符句型。

part5.q: The executive team approved the budget ------- the project could begin on schedule.
part5.ex: so that 表目的“以便”，符合邏輯；even though 表讓步、otherwise 表其他情況，語意不符。

part5.q: Please complete the online ------- to apply for a new bank account.
part5.ex: complete 需搭配名詞 application；apply、applicant、applying 詞性皆不符。

part5.q: The product launch was delayed ------- unanticipated manufacturing issues.
part5.ex: due to 表示“因為”，正確表達原因；except for 表示排除，語意不符。

part5.q: Many travelers used the hotel's shuttle service ------- convenience and cost savings.
part5.ex: for convenience and cost savings 為常見用法，表目的；其他介系詞語意不符。

part5.q: The team was praised for its ------- handling of the product launch crisis.
part5.ex: 需要形容詞 effective 修飾 handling；effect（名詞）、effectively（副詞）、effectiveness（名詞）皆不合。

part5.q: The manager explained the new budget policy, ------- helped employees understand the recent changes.
part5.ex: which 指代前面整句內容，正確連接兩句話。that 不能用來連接兩句完整句意。

part5.q: The CEO's statement was ------- by employees as a sign of continued company stability.
part5.ex: statement was interpreted（被解讀），被動語態正確；interpret 為動詞原形，語態不符。

part5.q: The culinary team is looking for a ------- supplier of fresh produce for the new restaurant.
part5.ex: 需求形容詞 reliable 修飾 supplier；reliably（副詞）、reliability（名詞）、relies（動詞）皆不合。

part5.q: The ------- relocation of our head office will require all employees to update their contact information.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 upcoming，形容詞修飾 relocation。upcomingly 並非英文單字，upcome、upcomes 為動詞且用法不對。

part5.q: Please submit your quarterly sales reports ------- Friday at 5 p.m.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 by，指在某時間點之前。'at'、'on'、'between' 都不適合和截止時間搭配。

part5.q: Our company ------- a new volunteer program to support local communities.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 has launched，表現在過去開始並和現在有關。其他選項時態不符。

part5.q: The training workshop was so ------- that many employees requested additional sessions.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 beneficial，形容詞修飾 workshop。benefit、benefits 為名詞，benefiting 為動詞形式。

part5.q: Customers are eligible to file a warranty claim ------- the product fails within one year of purchase.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 if，表示條件。'so' 表結果，'for' 與 'while' 在此語境下不合適。

part5.q: The trade show offered a valuable ------- for networking with industry professionals.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 opportunity，名詞。其他選項不是名詞，不能與 'a valuable' 搭配。

part5.q: Before ------- your office, please inform the IT department so they can relocate your computer.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 vacating，before + V-ing。vacate 是原型，vacates、vacated 皆不正確。

part5.q: The quarterly sales team meeting will take place ------- the showroom on the second floor.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 in the showroom，表示地點。to, about, by 都不正確。

part5.q: Mr. Harris, ------- organized the volunteer event, will give a brief speech before dinner.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 who，修飾人且為主格。which 修飾事物，whom 作受格，whose 作所有格。

part5.q: Many employees expressed ------- about the possible disruption caused by the upcoming office move.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 concerns，名詞且須用複數。其他選項為動詞、形容詞或非正確詞形。

part5.q: The success of the last workshop was ------- due to the engaging trainers.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 largely，副詞修飾 'due to'。其他詞形不對。

part5.q: ------- the sales figures were lower than expected, the marketing team is developing a new strategy.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 Although，後接完整句子表示對比。Because 語意不符，despite 不加完整句，during 用於時間。

part5.q: All warranty claims ------- be submitted with proof of purchase.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 must，表必要。have、should have、are 均文法或語意錯誤。

part5.q: Ms. Lee explained the new volunteer program ------- detail at yesterday’s staff meeting.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 in detail，固定搭配。其他介系詞不合適。

part5.q: The company is moving its headquarters to a modern building; -------, all staff will have upgraded workspaces.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 consequently，表前因後果。since/because 為原因連接詞，unless 表除非。

part5.q: As part of the trade show, we ------- new products to potential clients.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 demonstrated，描述過去已發生的事件。demonstrate 現在式，have demonstrating/ demonstrating 語法錯誤。

part5.q: The training workshop focused on ------- employees with better customer service skills.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 providing，focus on + V-ing。provide 原型，provided 過去式，provision 名詞。

part5.q: Attendance at the quarterly sales meeting is ------- for all senior managers.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 mandatory，表「必須」的意思。mandate 名詞，mandatorily 副詞，mandating 動詞。

part5.q: He registered for the trade show ------- he could showcase his company's latest innovations.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 so that，表目的。despite 表讓步，unless 表條件，nevertheless 表轉折。

part5.q: The warranty claim was rejected because the required documentation was -------.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 incomplete，形容詞修飾 documentation。incompletion、completely、completeness 皆不恰當。

part5.q: The IT department is responsible for the ------- of secure passwords across all company devices.
part5.ex: 正確答案是implementation，因為空格需要名詞。implementing常令人混淆，但此處應用名詞不是動名詞。

part5.q: Due to unexpected weather conditions, the shipment ------- until next Monday.
part5.ex: will not arrive正確，表示未來不會到；arrives方向與文意不符，因為資訊涉及延遲。

part5.q: Applicants are advised to dress ------- when attending the job interview.
part5.ex: professionally是副詞，修飾dress。professional是形容詞，這裡需要副詞。

part5.q: Please let us know ------- you require any special accommodations for the upcoming conference.
part5.ex: if正確，用於條件句。since和although語意不合，unless表示除非，與句意不符。

part5.q: The budget proposal was rejected ------- a lack of supporting documentation.
part5.ex: due to正確，說明原因。instead of表示替代，語意不合。

part5.q: The conference organizer suggested that a larger venue ------- considered for next year.
part5.ex: 建議句後面用原形動詞，所以be正確。is雖像，但語法錯誤。

part5.q: The company has invested in advanced ------- systems to protect sensitive information from cyber threats.
part5.ex: security是正確的名詞。secure是形容詞，這裡需名詞修飾systems。

part5.q: Despite repeated warnings, some workers still failed to ------- the required safety equipment in the factory.
part5.ex: to後接原形動詞，所以選wear。wore是過去式，語法錯誤。

part5.q: The interview panel will review all the resumes ------- they select the candidates.
part5.ex: before正確，說明選擇之前的動作。even though語意矛盾。

part5.q: The manager asked ------- would be able to attend the meeting on short notice.
part5.ex: who正確，作主詞。whom是受詞，這裡語法不符。

part5.q: A sudden shortage of containers ------- the delay in shipping the goods.
part5.ex: 因果結構用caused。was caused語態錯誤（應在被動語態使用）。

part5.q: The final budget will be approved ------- all department heads submit their feedback by Friday.
part5.ex: provided（如果）表條件，合句意。otherwise語意不應用此處。

part5.q: New employees must complete the safety training program ------- the end of their first week.
part5.ex: by the end意指在...之前完成。beside與by混淆，實際意思完全不同。

part5.q: The shipping department is known for its ------- in delivering products on schedule.
part5.ex: reliability是名詞，修飾is known for。reliable是形容詞，語法錯誤。

part5.q: The IT team responded ------- to the attempted data breach, minimizing any potential damage.
part5.ex: promptly是正確副詞，表示動作速度快。promptness是名詞，語法錯誤。

part5.q: Mr. Tanaka was ------- as the keynote speaker for the annual international conference.
part5.ex: 被動語態應用selected。selection是名詞，語法錯誤。

part5.q: Before ------- the final report, please make sure all the figures are accurate.
part5.ex: 前置詞before後接動名詞submitting。submit雖常見，但語法不對。

part5.q: The factory installed additional fire alarms ------- enhance safety for all staff.
part5.ex: to enhance表示目的。from容易混淆但無法表達目的。

part5.q: The CFO reviewed the proposal carefully to ------- that all spending was justified.
part5.ex: ensure強調確保事情發生。assure常被誤用，但通常指安慰人而非確保事情。

part5.q: Ms. Lin was impressed by the candidate’s ------- to adapt to new technologies during the interview.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 ability，因為句子需要一個名詞來表達『能力』，而不是形容詞 able。

part5.q: The HR manager will contact you ------- your background check has been completed.
part5.ex: after 表示『之後』，符合句意；while 和 until 用於不同語境，unless（除非）意思不符。

part5.q: Applicants must submit all required documents ------- the online application portal.
part5.ex: through 表示『經由、透過』，與申請入口網站搭配自然；by、for、with 表達不同含意。

part5.q: The train ------- to depart at 10:45, but the schedule was changed due to maintenance issues.
part5.ex: was supposed（本來預計）正確，表過去計劃；is supposed 是現在式，語境不符。

part5.q: The press release ------- the company’s recent achievements is available on the official website.
part5.ex: about 表示『關於』，正確修飾 achievements；其他選項語意皆不通。

part5.q: All maintenance requests should be ------- reported to the building supervisor.
part5.ex: promptly（副詞）用來修飾動詞 reported，語法正確；其他選項為不同詞性或語意。

part5.q: The shipping department was delayed ------- a breakdown at the distribution center.
part5.ex: because of 指原因，適用於句中；although、however 表讓步或轉折，不符文意。

part5.q: Mr. Chang ------- for the position of marketing director last week.
part5.ex: applied 為過去式，和 last week 搭配；apply、applying、applies 為其他時態或形式。

part5.q: The company plans to enhance its reputation by issuing ------- press releases.
part5.ex: regular（形容詞）修飾名詞 press releases；regulate（動詞），regulation、regularity（名詞）。

part5.q: We were late to the meeting ------- the train was delayed for over an hour.
part5.ex: because 表原因，解釋遲到理由；unless、despite 和 as a result 用法皆不合語境。

part5.q: The newly hired employees ------- given a comprehensive orientation to company policies.
part5.ex: were 符合『employees』的複數過去被動語態；其他時態或主詞不符。

part5.q: To minimize shipping delays, the warehouse manager recommended more efficient ------- methods.
part5.ex: inventory（名詞）修飾 methods 表『庫存管理方法』；invent、inventive 和 invention 不符合搭配。

part5.q: The applicant was confident during the interview, ------- her lack of experience.
part5.ex: despite（儘管）正確連接反差語意，because/since（因為）和 due to（由於）不合邏輯。

part5.q: The supervisor instructed the staff ------- complete the onboarding forms before starting their duties.
part5.ex: instructed someone to do something（指示某人做某事）正確搭配，for/at/with 都不正確。

part5.q: ------- of the applicants who were interviewed this morning seemed highly qualified.
part5.ex: Most 用於可數複數『applicants』，最合適；much 用於不可數名詞，many 通常需有 of the。

part5.q: The manager asked ------- the new policy had been communicated to all employees.
part5.ex: whether（是否）用於間接問句，最合適；what、which、how much 皆不合文意。

part5.q: The public transportation system ------- updated its schedule to better accommodate commuters.
part5.ex: has（現在完成式）搭配 system（單數）；having、have 用法錯誤，had 為過去式。

part5.q: The maintenance crew will perform routine checks on all fire ------- equipment today.
part5.ex: safety 修飾名詞 equipment，表『安全設備』；其他詞性不符。

part5.q: The supplier failed to ------- the shipment before the agreed deadline.
part5.ex: to dispatch（不定詞原形）為正確用法；dispatching、dispatcher、dispatched 用法皆不對。

part5.q: The CEO made a ------- announcement regarding the firm’s expansion plans.
part5.ex: public announcement（公開聲明）為固定搭配；其他選項詞性或搭配用法錯誤。

part5.q: The supplier contract ------- that all invoices must be paid within 30 days of receipt.
part5.ex: states 為正確動詞形式，與主詞 contract 搭配。'state' 少了 s，不符主詞單數。

part5.q: All warranty claims will be processed ------- after the necessary documents are received.
part5.ex: promptly 為副詞，用來修飾動詞 processed。promptness 是名詞，語意不合。

part5.q: Guests are required to show a valid photo ID ------- check-in at the hotel.
part5.ex: upon check-in（辦理入住時）為正確搭配；during check-in 雖然可行但較少用。

part5.q: The retail store announced a ------- on all electronics, starting next week.
part5.ex: promotion（促銷活動）作名詞，正確；promotional 有形容詞功能，不可單獨作主詞。

part5.q: The contract should ------- signed by both parties before any orders are placed.
part5.ex: should 需要接原型動詞，be signed 為被動語態正確；is signed 錯誤。

part5.ex: for budget purposes 為常用片語，purposes 為複數名詞；purpose(單數)不常搭配。

part5.q: The new library is equipped ------- high-speed internet and comfortable reading areas.

part5.q: Library members can also renew their books ------- the online portal or at the front desk.

part5.q: Budget ------- must be submitted to the finance team by Friday.
part5.ex: requests 為名詞，指單據申請；requested 為過去分詞，語法不符。

part5.q: If the application is approved, you will be ------- to join the volunteer training session.
part5.ex: will be invited 為未來被動；invite 為動詞原形，語法錯誤。

part5.q: The marketing team is responsible for organizing promotional ------- for the museum exhibition.
part5.ex: activities 指多項推廣活動，最符合語境；activity(單數)較不自然。

part5.q: Business travelers often book accommodations that are conveniently ------- to the meeting venue.
part5.ex: conveniently located 為常用搭配；location 為名詞不搭配 conveniently。

part5.q: The property management firm is responsible for ------- the security codes monthly to prevent unauthorized access.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 'updating'，因為介系詞 'for' 後需要用動名詞。'update' 是原形，文法不對。

part5.q: If a warranty claim ------- within 30 days, the customer may not be eligible for free repairs.
part5.ex: 正確答案為 'is not submitted'，因為這是被動語態且主詞為單數。'are not submitted' 主詞不一致。

part5.q: To enhance IT security, all employees must use ------- passwords and change them regularly.
part5.ex: 'strong' 是正確的形容詞修飾 passwords；'strongly' 是副詞，不能修飾名詞。

part5.q: The leasing contract ------- that tenants are responsible for minor repairs inside the apartment.
part5.ex: 'states' 主詞是 contract（單數），故需用單數動詞。'state' 為複數型態，不對。

part5.q: ------- the heavy rain, the community event proceeded as planned and attracted over 200 visitors.
part5.ex: 'Despite' 表示儘管（有）下雨，其它選項語意不符。

part5.q: Customers can apply for additional banking services ------- the online portal or directly at a local branch.
part5.ex: 'through' 與 portal 搭配，表示透過網站。'into' 不符合語意。

part5.q: The charity fundraiser was so successful that it ------- enough money to support three local shelters.
part5.ex: 'raised' 是正確的過去式，'rose'（上升）意思不同且不及物。

part5.q: Please ensure that all network devices are ------- configured before granting them access to company resources.
part5.ex: 'properly' 是副詞修飾 configured。'proper' 是形容詞，文法不對。

part5.q: If you ------- your account password, please contact the IT help desk immediately.
part5.ex: 條件句裡用現在簡單式 'forget'，不是過去式 'forgot'。

part5.q: All warranty claim forms must be ------- in full before submission to avoid processing delays.
part5.ex: 'completed' 過去分詞當作被動形容詞。'completely' 為副詞，不能當補語。

part5.q: ------- the main speaker was late, the event organizers quickly rearranged the schedule.
part5.ex: 'Since' 表示由於、因為，文句合理。'Unless' 意義不通。

part5.q: The community center offers various facilities, ------- a conference hall and a gym.
part5.ex: 'including' 用來列舉，意思正確。'includes' 應做動詞，文法不符。

part5.q: Real estate agents should provide detailed ------- about the properties for lease to potential tenants.
part5.ex: 'information' 為不可數名詞，'informations' 錯誤（英語中不可數）。

part5.q: Tenants are advised not to share their building access codes ------- anyone outside the lease agreement.
part5.ex: 'share with' 為固定搭配，其他選項用法錯誤。

part5.q: The IT security team will notify users ------- a potential threat is detected on the network.
part5.ex: 'if' 聯接條件句，描述發生時通知。'while' 不通。

part5.q: Any customer ------- files a warranty claim must provide proof of purchase.
part5.ex: 'who' 為關係代名詞修飾人。'which' 用於事物，不正確。

part5.q: The annual charity auction was organized ------- the town council and several local businesses.
part5.ex: 'organized by' 是正確片語，表示主動方。'with' 意義含糊。

part5.q: The lease agreement should be reviewed carefully ------- both parties before it is signed.
part5.ex: 'reviewed by' 誰來審查，'for' 不正確。

part5.q: Bank customers should update their contact details, ------- they may not receive important notifications.
part5.ex: 'otherwise' 表示否則，前後句邏輯正確。'after' 不表轉折。

part5.q: The warranty does not cover ------- caused by improper use of the equipment.
part5.ex: 'damage' 做不可數名詞，表示損害。'damages' 在法律用語才可數，這裡不適用。

part5.q: The ------- of our new mobile app is scheduled for the end of this month.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 launch，因為這裡需要一個名詞來指產品發表。launching 雖是名詞但此處語感不合，其他選項為動詞形式。

part5.q: If the restaurant opening is ------- by rain, the event will be moved indoors.
part5.ex: Delayed 是被動語態，符合“被延遲”的意思。delaying 通常主動用法，delay/delays 為動詞原形/三單。

part5.q: The manager requested that everyone ------- the training workshop on time.
part5.ex: request that 子句後接動詞原形（虛擬語氣），其他選項時態、詞性不合。

part5.q: Our marketing team is ------- preparing for the upcoming product launch.
part5.ex: actively 是副詞修飾 preparing，active 為形容詞，其他選項詞性不合。

part5.q: The quarterly sales report will be discussed ------- the meeting tomorrow afternoon.
part5.ex: during 用於表示時間範圍“在會議期間”，among 指多者之間，toward/without 不合語意。

part5.q: A software update ------- every three months to improve performance and fix bugs.
part5.ex: 被動語態 is released 指“被發布”，表達公司定期發布更新。releasing/to release/release 都語法不正確。

part5.q: Because the new health clinic is centrally located, it is ------- for many residents.
part5.ex: 此處需要形容詞 convenient 修飾 clinic，convenience 是名詞、conveniently 為副詞。

part5.q: Employees ------- complete all modules of the training workshop before the deadline.
part5.ex: must 是助動詞，符合“必須完成”的意思；has to 雖也表示必須，但主詞 employees 為複數，不合文法。

part5.q: Quarterly sales have risen ------- 20% compared to last year.
part5.ex: increase by 表示“增加的幅度”，其餘選項皆不合搭配用法。

part5.q: The restaurant opening, ------- was announced last week, attracted a lot of attention.
part5.ex: which 用於非限定性定語從句，修飾前面的“開幕活動”。that 雖也可引導從句，但不能用於非限定性。

part5.q: The staff quickly ------- the new software update with minimal guidance.
part5.ex: adapted to 新系統意指員工很快“適應”了新軟體，其他動詞搭配不正確。

part5.q: The health clinic provides a ------- of medical services, including dental and vision care.
part5.ex: range 做名詞指“範圍”，ranged/ranging/ranges 為動詞或現在分詞，不符語法。

part5.q: The team decided to delay the product launch ------- they could implement additional features.
part5.ex: so that 表示“為了…”，後方可接目的；despite 表達讓步，語意不合。

part5.q: All employees are ------- to attend the training workshop next Friday.
part5.ex: are required to V 為被動語態，全體員工“被要求”參加。requiring/require 為動詞，不合語法。

part5.q: ------- the high demand, reservations for the new restaurant are strongly recommended.
part5.ex: Due to 表示原因“由於～”，其他選項語意不合。

part5.q: The IT department will notify users ------- the software update has been completed.
part5.ex: once 表示“一旦…就…”，描述軟體更新完成的時間點。provided 表達條件，語意不合。

part5.q: The quarterly sales report contains several ------- insights into market trends.
part5.ex: 此處需要形容詞 valuable 修飾 insights，相當於“有價值的”。value/valuation/valuing 為名詞或動詞，不合。

part5.q: The chef developed a new menu item ------- feedback from customers.
part5.ex: based on 意為“根據”，符合語意。except for 指“除此之外”，用法不合。

part5.q: The training workshop will cover both theory ------- practical applications.
part5.ex: and 連接兩個並列成分，意思是“理論和實作”。but 用於轉折，語氣不符題意。

part5.q: To stay competitive, the company invests heavily in the ------- of innovative products.
part5.ex: development 為名詞“開發”，句意為“投入於開發創新產品”。developer 為人，developed/developing 為動詞形式或分詞，不符語意。

part5.q: The manager requested that all business travelers submit their ------- reports within three days of returning.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 expense，因為 'expense report' 是固定搭配。'expenses' 通常指花費本身，不是報告。

part5.q: Before ------- an airline ticket, check the cancellation policy carefully to avoid unnecessary fees.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 purchasing，因為介係詞 before 需接動名詞。purchase 和 purchases 不是適當用法。

part5.q: The new restaurant is opening next month ------- it receives all the necessary permits on time.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 if，因為只有在獲得許可證的情況下才會開幕。unless 意義與句子衝突。

part5.q: Passengers ------- for more than two hours are eligible for complimentary refreshments.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 delayed，此為過去分詞當形容詞修飾 passengers。delaying 語意不對。

part5.q: Due to a recent IT security upgrade, employees must ------- their passwords every 90 days.

part5.q: Customer complaints are handled ------- by the service department to ensure rapid resolution.

part5.q: Please inform the front desk ------- your luggage is missing upon arrival.

part5.q: Staff members ------- to the opening ceremony are asked to RSVP by Friday.

part5.q: Only employees with proper ------- can access confidential files on the company server.

part5.q: Public transportation in the city became much ------- after the new subway line opened.

part5.q: The IT department responded ------- to the security breach, preventing data loss.

part5.q: Travelers are reminded to keep their receipts ------- reimbursement purposes.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 for 表示目的。on reimbursement purposes 並不常見。

part5.q: Please reply to this message ------- you have further questions regarding your booking.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 if，有疑問時聯絡。unless 代表無疑問時，語意相反。

part5.q: The bus system provides ------- connections to the airport, making business travel more convenient.

part5.q: The chef's signature dish quickly gained ------- among local food critics.

part5.q: The new IT security policy will take effect ------- the beginning of next month.

part5.q: The press release should be written in clear and ------- language to ensure it is easily understood.

part5.q: The merger announcement was met ------- concern by many long-term employees.

part5.q: The safety manager reminded staff ------- always wear protective equipment in hazardous areas.

part5.q: Our retail stores ------- increasing their discount offers to boost holiday sales.
part5.ex: 主詞 'stores' 為複數，所以需用 'are'；其他選項語法不符。

part5.q: Any issue with the leased office space should ------- to the property manager immediately.

part5.q: The team analyzed customer complaints ------- they could identify recurring issues.

part5.q: We will not process your application ------- all required documents are received.

part5.q: The ------- of the warehouse was inspected for fire safety compliance.
part5.ex: 'structure' (名詞) 為正確答案；'structural' 是形容詞，'structured' 是過去分詞，'structurely' 並非單字。

part5.q: The event will ------- be postponed if the weather conditions do not improve.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 likely，修飾被動語態 will be postponed。likely to 後要接動詞原形，likelihood 是名詞，like 表喜好。

part5.q: The minutes from last week's board meeting can be found ------- the shared company drive.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 on，on the drive 為慣用介係詞用法。in 一般指箱子、書籍等，at 不合語意。

part5.q: Staff members were ------- informed of the new office location to ensure a smooth transition.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 promptly，副詞修飾被動語態。prompt 是形容詞或動詞，prompting 分詞，prompted 過去式或過去分詞。

part5.q: Library users should keep noise levels to a minimum ------- others can work comfortably.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 so that，表示目的。despite 和 even though 表讓步，however 是副詞。

part5.q: The ------- sales report will be presented at the monthly management meeting on Friday.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 quarterly，因為需要一個形容詞來修飾 sales report。tempting distractor 'quarter' 是名詞，不能修飾名詞。

part5.q: Our IT department ------- the software update on all office computers by next week.
part5.ex: 使用未來完成式 'will complete'，因為句子說明的是未來的動作。'completed' 是過去式，不合文意。

part5.q: Please sign the supplier contract ------- you have read all terms and conditions carefully.
part5.ex: 使用 after 表示簽署行為應在閱讀完合約條款後進行，'unless' 則表示『除非』，語意錯誤。

part5.q: The new office is ------- located near public transportation and several restaurants.
part5.ex: 應使用副詞 'conveniently' 修飾動詞 'located'，'convenient' 為形容詞，不能修飾動詞。

part5.q: The library will extend its services ------- increase in visitor numbers this semester.
part5.ex: 正確答案 'because of' 表示因為訪客數增加，其餘皆不合語意。

part5.q: The building manager asked ------- to return any unused access cards before the relocation.
part5.ex: 'everyone' 指所有人都要歸還門禁卡，'someone' 只代表某人，意思不同。

part5.q: Suppliers are expected to deliver goods in ------- with the contract specifications.
part5.ex: 'in accordance with' 是正確的片語，'according' 需連用 to，'accord' 和 'accordingly' 不合語意。

part5.q: Although the final lease agreement was signed yesterday, the new tenant ------- move in until July.
part5.ex: 用 'will not' 表示未來不會搬入，'did not' 係過去式，與後文 'until July' 不符。

part5.q: The quarterly sales figures ------- by various factors such as market demand and pricing strategy.
part5.ex: 需被動語態 'are affected'，因銷售數字是受其他因素影響。'is affecting' 主詞複數不符。

part5.q: Library members may renew books online, ------- is a convenient option for many users.
part5.ex: 'which' 正確連結前句內容作補充說明，其他選項語法均不對。

part5.q: All employees ------- to report any problems with the new software update immediately.
part5.ex: 主詞 'All employees' 為複數，所以用 'are required'，'is required' 錯誤。

part5.q: The supplier contract ------- during the annual review meeting last week.
part5.ex: 用過去式被動語態 'was discussed'，表現合約是被討論。

part5.q: The office relocation was postponed ------- unexpected construction delays.
part5.ex: 'due to' 用於說明原因，'aside from' 意思為『除了...之外』，不合文意。

part5.q: The landlord offered a more ------- lease agreement to attract tenants in a competitive market.
part5.ex: 需要用形容詞 'flexible' 修飾 'lease agreement'，'flexibly' 是副詞，不合語意。

part5.q: We plan to relocate the main office ------- minimize business disruptions.
part5.ex: 'in order to' 正確表達目的，'so that' 後需接完整句子，這裡不合語法。

part5.q: The contract renewal process is usually ------- and takes less than one week.
part5.ex: 'straightforward' 形容詞，正確修飾 process；'straightforwardly' 副詞，這裡不合語意。

part5.q: The real estate agent will send property listings ------- e-mail to interested clients.
part5.ex: 'by e-mail' 是標準片語，'at' 和 'on' 均不正確。

part5.q: The system administrator completed the software update ------- the office was still open to staff.
part5.ex: 'while' 表示兩個動作同時發生，其他連接詞語意不符。

part5.q: Recent sales data show a noticeable ------- in demand for commercial leases.
part5.ex: 要用名詞 'increase' 搭配 'a noticeable'，'increased' 是形容詞，不合語意。

part5.q: The library has launched a ------- program to educate patrons about new digital services.
part5.ex: 'promotional program' 是正確搭配；'promotion program' 用法不自然。

qs.ex: 正確答案是 'be'，這是使用使役動詞 'must' 加上原形動詞。'been'（完成式），'being'（進行式），'is'（第三人稱單數現在式）皆不合文法。
'actively'（副詞）正確修飾 'involved'。'active' 是形容詞，'activates' 是動詞，'activity' 是名詞，皆不合文意。
'In addition,'（此外）承接前文感謝後補充說明；'Nevertheless,'（然而）語氣相反，'For example,' 需再舉例，'Otherwise,' 表示否則，皆不合文意。

o: Please remember to arrive at least one hour before the opening to help with setup.
Shipping rates for overseas customers will increase next month.
If you have questions about the new accounting software, contact IT.
The cafeteria will have special discounts on hot beverages during the summer.
qs.ex: 正確答案是第一句，提醒團隊早到以協助布展，和展覽準備事項直接相關。其他選項與展會主題無關，不合語境。

正確用法應是形容詞『specific』修飾名詞『needs』，『specifies』與『specification』語意、詞性不對。

docs.text:
To: All Sales Staff
From: Logistics Department
Subject: Update on Shipping Delays

Due to recent issues with our main supplier, there have been unexpected delays in the shipment of several products. {1} efforts are being made to resolve these issues, we ask that you inform your customers about the possible delays in advance. Please do not promise a delivery date until you {2} confirmation from the logistics team. {3}.

In addition, make sure to update the order status in the system to reflect any changes. Your cooperation is important to maintain customer trust and satisfaction. {4} any questions arise, contact the logistics department immediately.

qs.ex: 正確答案是 Although，因為這裡需要一個對比連接詞來引出雖然有努力，後面還是請同仁通知客戶，最常見的錯誤選項是 Meanwhile，但它意思是同時，不通順。
正確答案是 have received，因為句子是說“直到你已經收到確認為止”，必須用現在完成式。常錯選 will receive，但語意上是未來，不符句意。

o: This policy will help prevent misunderstandings and ensure smooth communication with clients.
The warehouse team is not responsible for updating order status.
You should never contact the supplier directly regarding this matter.
Please restock items as soon as they arrive.
qs.ex: 正確答案是第一個選項，這句話解釋為什麼要提前通知客戶，可以銜接上下文；其他選項不是說明政策或溝通目的，與前後文無關。
正確答案是 If，因為是在說“如果有問題請聯絡”，是條件句。常錯選 Therefore，但這是因果連接詞，文意不符。

docs.text:
To: All Department Heads
From: Finance Office
Subject: Annual Budget Approval

We are pleased to announce that the executive board has {1} the annual budget for the upcoming fiscal year. {2} This will allow all departments to begin planning and allocating resources as outlined in their proposals. Please note that any requests for additional funds must {3} in writing and submitted to the Finance Office no later than July 15.

qs.ex: 本題需要過去分詞作為動詞 (has approved)，而 approval 是名詞，approve 是動詞原形，approving 是動名詞或現在分詞。

o: The finance department will distribute the budget details later this week.
Please disregard all previous correspondence related to the budget.
A final review is not necessary under current policies.
The executive board is seeking additional budget suggestions.
qs.ex: 只有第一句（財務部將在本週稍後發佈預算細節）適合此句後敘述開始規劃資源，其他選項不是本段主旨。
requests must be made 為正確被動語態搭配；make 和 making 結構不對，been made 少了助動詞。
With your cooperation 是正確的固定用語，強調因有合作使得運作順利；其他介系詞用法不合。

正確答案為 'Additionally,'，表示遞增資訊『此外』。'Likely' 與語意無關，'Nevertheless' 表示轉折，也不適合。

o: Library staff are always available to assist members in locating materials or using electronic resources.
Members should contact the library before visiting.
Borrowed materials must be returned within one week.
Only children can participate in library events.
qs.ex: 正確答案是 'Library staff are always available...'，這句話銜接前後文，說明圖書館員可以幫忙尋找資料。其他選項與上下文不連貫。
正確答案 'Furthermore,' 表示再補充一點資訊。'On the contrary' 轉折語意與內容不符，不應使用。

qs.ex: 此句與檢查行李及政策主題相關，放在這裡合適；其他選項與本文主題無直接關聯。
Additionally 用來補充說明，是銜接上文『為避免延誤』到下文『未遵守政策會如何』的正確連接詞；Regardless, Nevertheless 有轉折語意，不符文意。
policy（政策）意思正確；policies 為複數，不合語境，policy's 為所有格或縮寫不符文意，policying 不是正確詞形。

regulations （規定）正確地指明網站上公布的規定；regulators（監管者）錯誤，regulate（動詞）及regularity（名詞/常態）皆不合文意。
will be charged 表示未來若行李超重會被收費，用被動語態合適；is charging（主語應是人），was charged（過去式）及 are to charge（語態錯誤）都不合文意。

o: For further details or clarification, please visit our official website or contact our support team.
Passengers are reminded that our airport locations vary by destination.
We encourage all passengers to check in at least three hours before departure.
Travel insurance is recommended for all international flights.
qs.ex: 本句插在最後，提供聯絡資訊，與前文政策細節相關；其餘選項雖與旅遊相關，但跟行李政策無關，因此不合文意。

這裡需要名詞 'patience'，表達感謝對方的耐心；'patient' 是形容詞，'patently' 是副詞，'patienceful' 並不是正確單字。

qs.ex: 正確答案是 Due to，因為要解釋因為政策改變導致職責調整。Except for（除了）、Instead of（而不是）、Despite（儘管）皆不合文意。
正確答案是 In addition,（此外），前面講職責調整，這裡補充offer letter的規定。However（然而）、Otherwise（否則）、For example（例如）語氣不合。

o: To help make the transition smoother for our new colleagues,
The office will be closed for renovations next week,
This document has been archived for future use,
Please forward this message to your clients,
qs.ex: 正確答案是 To help make the transition smoother for our new colleagues,，因為前後都在談新員工入職安排。其他三句都與上下文無關。
正確答案是 Additionally（此外），符合前面提出的建議後再補充訓練資料。Meanwhile（同時）、Nevertheless（然而）及 Otherwise（否則）語意不自然。

o: This change is intended to create a more consistent public image for the company.
It is not necessary to inform anyone about this change.
This information should not be included in future press releases.
The new visual identity will be launched next year.
qs.ex: A 選項說明此變更的目的，承上文 'updated guidelines'，語意連貫；B、C、D 與文意不符或資訊無關。

o: Employees are welcome to bring their families to the ceremony.

Nominees will be required to pay an admission fee.

‘to’ 後需原形動詞，故選 'submit'；'submission' (名詞)、'submitting' (動名詞)、'submits' (第三人稱單數動詞) 均不合文法。

To: All Staff
From: Community Outreach Office
Subject: Instructions for Annual Charity Walk

Thank you for volunteering to help with our Annual Charity Walk this Saturday. Please arrive at the registration table by 7:00 a.m. to receive your assignment. 正確答案 1 (friendly and approachable manner) manner後面需用形容詞。approach和approaching皆為動詞或分詞，不符合語法。approached為過去分詞，也不合句意。

o: If you finish your assignment early, please check with the team leader for additional tasks.
For more information, visit our company website.

正確答案是A 'show your appreciation'（表達感謝）為常見搭配。B、C、D與 appreciation 不搭配。

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

qs.ex: 正確答案是pleased，因為『is pleased to announce』是標準的慣用說法；pleasing或pleasant用於形容事物本身令人愉快，pleasure 是名詞，不適用於這裡。
正確答案是In addition to，表示除了引入新設備之外還有其他措施；On account of 是因為，According to 通常用於引述，As for 表示轉換話題。

o: The upgrades include installing emergency stop buttons and improved ventilation systems.
Our company has received several awards for product quality.
Demand for our products is expected to rise this year.
Customers can tour the facility upon request.
qs.ex: 正確答案是The upgrades include installing emergency stop buttons and improved ventilation systems，這一句自然承接前文提到的安全升級措施；其他選項則偏離主題或不相關。
正確答案是implementing，這裡需用動名詞作介系詞by的受詞；implemented是過去分詞，implement是動詞原形，implementation是名詞，皆不符文法。

docs.text:
To: All Staff
From: Office Administrator
Subject: Important Catering Order Update

Dear Team,

This is to notify everyone about changes to our catering order policy, which will {1} starting next Monday. Previously, orders were accepted up to noon on the day of your event. {2} , all requests must now be submitted at least 48 hours in advance to ensure timely preparation and delivery. {3} , exceptions cannot be made without approval from the department manager. {4}

Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,
Cynthia Lee
Office Administrator

qs.ex: 正確答案是 A（take effect），用於描述規定正式開始實施；B 和 D 文法錯誤，C 為過去式，與時間“next Monday”不符。
正確答案是 A（However），文意為“然而”，用來對比原本的規定與新規定；B 代表因果關係，C 舉例，D 表示否則，皆不合文意。
B（Additionally）用來補充說明新的政策內容。A 表結果，C 表示否則，D 表具體說明，都不符補充語氣。

o: If you have already submitted a request this week, you do not need to resubmit it.
All employees are encouraged to try the new catering menu items next month.
The catering provider has increased its delivery charges for all departments.
You may contact the building manager for details about parking arrangements.
qs.ex: A 適合放在政策說明後，補充已經遞交申請的人不用再提交。B、C 和 D 與訂餐政策和上下文無直接關聯。

docs.text:
New Art Exhibit Opens at Downtown Museum

The Downtown Museum is pleased to announce the opening of its latest exhibition, "Colors of Change." {1} features works from both established and emerging artists, each exploring the shifting landscape of contemporary society through vivid hues and bold techniques. {2} the significance of art in capturing moments of transformation, the exhibit invites viewers to reflect on their own experiences. 

The exhibition will run from June 15 through September 10, with special workshops and talks scheduled throughout the summer. {3} To ensure public safety, all visitors are required to reserve tickets online in advance. {4}

For more information, visit the museum's official website or contact the visitor services desk by phone or email.

qs.ex: It 正確地代表『Colors of Change』展覽，是單數名詞，符合主詞；They 對應複數，與前文不符。
Recognizing 作為現在分詞，正確用於引導原因，說明整個展覽的主題。Recognize 為動詞原形，不適合此句文法結構。

o: Guests are encouraged to arrive 15 minutes before their scheduled time.
All workshops have already been fully booked for the summer.
The museum will be closed on Mondays during the exhibit.
Parking is not available at the museum.
qs.ex: 此句提醒訪客提前到達，與預約和安全措施連貫。其他選項和現有內容無直接關聯，會打斷前後語意。

o: Additionally, masks are required for entry.
However, the exhibit is free for children under 12.
For this reason, many people prefer guided tours.
Otherwise, visitors may forget the event.
qs.ex: Additionally, masks are required for entry，接續前句關於安全要求。其他選項無法合理承接上文，語意跳接。

The event was first held over ten years ago.

To: All Employees

Subject: New Guidelines for Business Travel

Due to recent changes in corporate policy, employees are required to follow new procedures when arranging business travel. {1} booking trips through our approved travel agency, employees should request authorization from their department manager. {2} This measure ensures that all travel expenses are compliant with our cost-saving initiatives. qs.ex: 正確答案是Before，表達『在透過旅行社訂票之前』。Despite 表示儘管，與句意不符。

o: However, travel booked outside official channels will not be reimbursed.
Employees may ignore this policy if they travel frequently.
All travel requests will be canceled automatically.

qs.ex: 正確答案是However, travel booked outside official channels will not be reimbursed.因為這句話承接前句，強調規定的重要性；其他選項跟上下文無邏輯或矛盾。

docs.text:
Business Travel: Tips for Success

For professionals who frequently travel for work, preparation is essential for smooth and productive trips. Planning can help travelers minimize stress and maximize efficiency. {1} creating a detailed itinerary, travelers should also allow for unexpected changes, such as flight delays or last-minute meetings. Packing efficiently is another key aspect; bringing only necessary items {2} avoid excess baggage fees and make airport transfers quicker.

{3}

Finally, travelers are advised to stay connected with their office. Checking email regularly and scheduling daily check-ins with colleagues can ensure that nothing important is missed while away. Although business travel can be challenging, a little {4} can make each trip as successful as possible.

qs.ex: 正確答案In addition to（除了…之外還…）前面是準備行程，後面是要留意意外狀況，語意上要用「除了…以外還要」；After與Despite語意不合，As a result of（由於）也無法連接兩個動作。
正確答案can help to（可以幫助…），語意完整且文法正確；helps with後面不接動詞原形，is helping in語法錯誤，helping to缺乏主詞。

o: Many professionals recommend bringing healthy snacks and a refillable water bottle to stay energized during long travel days.
Carefully reading local customs is not necessary for every business destination.
Choosing the most expensive airline is always the best option.
Booking accommodation at the last minute usually leads to better rates.
qs.ex: 正確答案句1，前文講旅行準備，後文提現場溝通與效率，只有帶健康零食和水瓶這句最貼合上下文；其他選項內容不合或語氣太武斷。
正確答案organization（名詞：有條理、組織），修飾success；organized（形容詞）、organizing（動名詞/現在分詞）、organizer（組織者）文意不合。
